text:
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] Prod canary starting in ~15m for release v2025.04.12. Change window 04/12 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2025.04.12. Backout runbook: https://kb.redwood/runbooks/backout-v2 (see section 3: quick-unpin).

marco: @oncall quick heads-up — this release includes a lightweight schema migration + cache key change. Requesting pin until canary stability verified. :eyes:

alice: Staging perf shows ~12% 95th latency bump on token-generation for long contexts. I'm running a local repro against staging traffic.

sre-lead: Noted. If canary degrades, fallback plan per runbook is: pin traffic and route to previous stable release (v2025.04.11). See runbook step: runbook#rollback -> step 2: unpin + restart worker pool. I'll be standing by. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Canary started — instances: gpu-canary-7,gpu-canary-8. Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.internal/prod/canary/v2025.04.12. Initial ramp in ~5m.

alice: Repro complete. Root cause points to kv-cache miss growth for long-context prompts after the cache-key change. Might be fixable via config toggle but needs validation.

marco: Proposal: hold the rollout, set pin ratio to 50/50 pause (effectively hold), and open hotfix branch. If metrics don't recover within 10m we execute backout per KB. Agree? :thumbsup:

sre-lead: +1. Add opsbot to take the pin/unpin action on command.

opsbot: Ready. Quick operator snippets: `deployctl pin release v2025.04.12 --ratio 0.0` to pin to zero, or `deployctl revert --target v2025.04.11 --force` to force rollback. Also can run `deployctl status --release v2025.04.12` to check progress.

alice: Running a prod-like perf test now against the canary image. Will report in ~6m.

marco: OK hold for perf. Alert condition: 95th latency > baseline + 8% over 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> initiate backout. Otherwise proceed to 20% after green.

alice: Results: 95th is +9.8% after applying the config toggles, repro is consistent. Not good.

sre-lead: Execute rollback now. opsbot, please run revert (per runbook emergency path).

opsbot: Executing: `deployctl revert --target v2025.04.11 --force` — starting staged rollback to standby pool, initiating worker-drain and health-check pin. Notifying infra for worker pool drain.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by opsbot. Linking backout runbook: https://kb.redwood/runbooks/backout-v2#emergency-unpin . Change log entry will be created automatically: https://redwood.internal/changelog/1743219999.

marco: Filing short postmortem notes and tagging release owners. Will update release notes to mark this roll as reverted and add RCA pointer.

alice: Dumping logs + perf artifacts: traces -> https://logs.internal/trace/1743219999, flamegraphs -> https://perf.internal/flame/1743219999.

sre-lead: Thanks — once rollback completes let's re-run a controlled canary using quantized model variant as Optimize suggested, then re-run smoke + perf before reattempt.

marco: +1. Closing loop: update runbook if checksum mismatch across cache keys caused miss growth. I'll add a short blurb in KB. :memo:
